originalSeed.protection: Original rig hierarchy/rest/world/scale/binds/poses, source object data/material/images, face/scalp/ears/cheek and protected packed+decoded normals remain immutable. No facial authoring or added bones.

repairGeometry.method: Restore only the missing canonical neck patch below the flat body cut, retaining every original displayed body triangle and position. Clip original canonical triangles at Z=1.55. Retain the unchanged source head upper mesh clipped at Z=1.575. Connect those two planar loops through monotone polar-angle sections. Do not interpolate ray sections toward the old concave nonplanar shoulder cut.

triangulation.primitive: Explicit triangles only on derived body and neck; inherited protected head triangles retain exact source order.
triangulation.originalDiagonals: Use actual source loop-triangle vertex and corner IDs from the frozen canonical/source mesh. No arbitrary n-gon resampling or quad diagonal replacement.
triangulation.clippedTriangleRule: Three retained/intersection points yield one triangle. A clipped convex four-point source triangle uses a declared diagonal/fan from a retained original vertex, never a fan of three collinear cut-edge points.
triangulation.ringBridge: Cyclic zipper using monotone angle coordinates, consistent winding and original boundary vertices. Do not emit three vertices on one source-edge subdivision.
triangulation.saveReopen: Actual evaluated triangles at rest and every measured sample must exactly match saved explicit triangle IDs and declared polygon/corner lineage. Cached pre-save n-gon IDs are not authoritative.

sectionContract.axes: Native metres, +X forward/+Z up/-Y left. Frame root +0.65 X retained once.
sectionContract.phase: Common +X ray defines zero; orient outer loops counterclockwise in XY. Every angle increment must be strictly positive around both source planar loops and each complete intermediate section.
sectionContract.containment: Require one closed degree-two loop per section, no segment crossings, positive winding, finite nonzero triangles and monotone section Z. Retain exact source cut vertices; any extra knot has explicit edge ancestry.
sectionContract.bodyRestHalfSpace: Every used body vertex Z <= float32(1.55). All body cut vertices have the identical Float32 Z value.
sectionContract.headRestHalfSpace: Every used head vertex Z >= float32(1.55); upper source/inner cut remain Z >= float32(1.575). Body/head meet only at the exact declared cut seam.
sectionContract.innerClosure: Inner lining closes at the upper head cut plane with inward-shell orientation and explicit integer-index triangulation. It does not follow the widened body boundary.
sectionContract.tolerancePolicy: No contact epsilon, eligible mask, source identity or normal tolerance is relaxed to hide a failure.

fieldContract.originalFullReference: body52 originalFullWeights is the raw FULL control. It is not foundation-source.npz canonicalWeights, which is already conditioned. Its originalFullXYZ is exactly the canonical source geometry; renderedBodySourceIDs maps all original 9037 body rows exactly.
fieldContract.originalBodyPrefix: Preserve actual source FULL and authored FOUR outside admitted semantic edits. This topology unit does not authorize unrelated shoulder/hip retuning. Record the exact touched original IDs; prefer zero original-row weight edits.
fieldContract.newNeckAuthorship: Freeze explicit at-most-four semantic fields before execution, using the admitted body04d chest/neck/ipsilateral shoulder/upper-arm base with arm fade before head influence begins. Keep the actual cut-edge neck/head field rather than assuming head-only. New deliberate FULL=FOUR fields are labeled authored, never an unchanged source control.
fieldContract.newCanonicalPatchReference: Retain raw source full and conditioned four reference rows plus source-edge interpolation arrays even where a new explicit seam field is authored. Preserve full source provenance instead of dropping controls to claim zero loss.
fieldContract.requiredReadback: Actual native vertex-group FULL and normalized FOUR rows must match authored arrays; FOUR maximum4, sum within1e-6. Compare all mesh regions, raw and normalized FULL LBS, native evaluated XYZ, and meaningful FULL/FOUR loss.

protectedCornerGate.protectedSourceVertexPositions: All original head XYZ stays exact in this proposal. Every source triangle incident to a protected vertex is unchanged. All original geometric contributor vertices retain XYZ; actual raw and decoded protected corner frames must pass independently after save/reopen.
protectedCornerGate.uvPBR: Protected source corner UVs and original packed image/material bytes exact. Derived lower UV ancestry explicit.
protectedCornerGate.rawNormal: INT16_2D protected packed values exact, zero changed corners after save/reopen.
protectedCornerGate.decodedRestNormal: All 176435 source protected corners exactly once in both controls with zero decoded vector delta.
protectedCornerGate.decodedMovingNormal: Measure actual native evaluated moving corner normals and exported/consumed skin normals on the same pose stream. Reopened rest equality alone cannot close this gate.

rest: Independent original34 and copied/original51 preservation passes.
Actual explicit saved/reopened triangles and all vertex/corner ancestry match.
Closed/simple/positive-winding planar sections and rest half-spaces pass.
Head/head, body/head and body/body eligible proper crossing counts zero. All finite contacts, degenerates and intentional aliases classified.
moving: Same-candidate rest, raised, asymmetric, crouch and grounded idle/jump-land snapshots with exact driver hashes.
Native/manual FULL/FOUR parity, actual full/four loss and head/body/self/boxer/cheek contacts measured.
No full wardrobe or phone acceptance implied by a neck pilot.

playedEvidence.required: Parent judges uninterrupted gray and PBR clips of the same source at full-body and neck-detail cameras, front/rear/both profiles/three-quarter, normal and slow motion. Moving normal and geometry reports must use the identical source/driver/time/camera pins.
playedEvidence.forbiddenClaims: No posed still, source orbit, rest normal equality, legacy game gate or lower contact count qualifies topology/motion/art.
playedEvidence.drivers: Keep anatomical stress and grounded support clips separate; do not combine unrelated47/50/native pose streams.

unchangedFailures: Body03 boxer crotch clearance failures remain a separate coherent construction unit.
Source shoulder/hip pose failures, wardrobe fit and physical-device/player gates remain open.
stopRule: One bounded canonical-patch/planar-section candidate after parent checkpoint. If it fails, localize actual evaluated source/new triangles and anatomical cause; do not restart density/radius/phase/weight sweeps under new names.
